Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : beti Shivangi ki vidaee par ro pare chhote sarkar, ab jana hoga jel !
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shahi shadi (25 navanbar 2026) ki taja laiv apdets — jahan paitrik ganv nadvan (barh, patna) men bhavy ghurdaur (Horse Race) shuru ho gaee hai, kendriy mantri lalan sinh ne ghurdaur ka shubharanbh kiya hai, brijbhushan sharan sinh helikoptar se nadvan pahunche hain, vijeta ke lie mahindra thar (Mahindra Thar) inam men rakhi gaee hai, aur 4 se 5 lakh mehmanon ke lie 150 pakvan va mini jaypur thim par sajavat ki gaee hai.
